title: Popeye the Sailor
paragraphs: Every title appears twice as an alternate transfer/encode.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: NBC Red / Wheatena run (September 10, 1935 to March 28, 1936) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], WABC / Wheatena run (August 31, 1936 to February 26, 1937) on [[org|org.b1c76a6702c1bee9|WABC]], and CBS / Popsicle run (May 2, 1938 to July 29, 1938) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Anne Hummert (producer), Charles Lawrence (performer), Elzie Segar (creator), Frank Hummert (producer), Jimmy Donnelly (performer), Olive Lamoy (performer), and Detmar Poppen (performer).

The stories often return to Popeye radio preservation and duplicate transfers, children’s adventure comedy, Popeye / Thimble Theatre character property, food and strength gag, Wheatena-sponsored radio marketing, and non-OTR kiddie-record contamination.

The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Sparse survival and mixed-corpus contamination, 1935-1938 Popeye radio adaptations, Popeye debuts in Thimble Theatre, and Wheatena sponsorship changes Popeye food references.
